items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Handles user authentication with the remote API, manages access tokens, and provides a unified catalog cache (identities and snapshots stored independently, mesh PLY geometry cached per snapshot). Stores authentication state in scriptcontext.sticky.
